verdict.rationale: The patent filing path documents a credential-based identity wall that a person can set up remotely: "You'll need your One Login details if you have them, or you can set them up" (uk-ipo-docs-8, uk-ipo-supp-2). Nothing in the pack confirms that sign-in uses MFA, or rules out biometric liveness, in-person checks or posted PINs. The trade mark online filing route's sign-in is also undescribed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the MFA factors used at sign-in, confirmation that no biometric liveness, in-person or posted-PIN step is required, sign-in details for trade mark filing and management, independent or hands-on corroboration.
